items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And he will say that Duke Ellington has a very big music. I know.

ctx.x: And he will say that Duke Ellington has a very big music. I know. And Bill Berry said, “I want to tell young musicians everything” he once said. That’s very good. He’s a very nice person.
Really, he sure is. And Ellington had some great clarinet players in his band himself.
